facts.text: Deborah mentions that Anna has a pendant worn in memory of her mother.

evidence.quote: Anna also has a pendant that she wears in memory of her mother! This also brought us closer.

facts.text: Jolene states that having reminders can serve as a source of strength when needed.

evidence.quote: It's nice to have those reminders as a source of strength when we need it.

facts.text: Deborah encourages Jolene to rely on her sources of strength and to stay in touch.

evidence.quote: Life's tough but hang in there. Look to your sources of strength and you'll do great. Stay in touch, take care of yourself, and know I'm always here to cheer you on!
